title: Reflexes
description: A harness that grows from what goes wrong: a reflex is an instruction made from a miss nobody covered, a condition (where it is said, for) and what to say there, tried live and kept or retired by its record. A trial reflex is said only on its exact condition and marked as a trial; a current one is said as any instruction is. A reflex never acts itself: it may name a map action for the agent to take through its own tools, and outside the map it only advises. What answers which miss is an answers link. Words only: what records each saying and judges whether its miss came back is the reflex_said pack, what draws it is reflex_view.

types.title: Reflex
types.description: An instruction grown from a miss: where it is said (for, its condition) and what to say (its note). A trial one is said only where its for names the place exactly, marked as a trial; its record promotes it to current or retires it. It never acts: it may name a map action (action, with its inputs) for the agent to take with its own tools.

until.description: When the situation it answers ends, as a date or a condition in words: past it, it is retired.

action.description: A map action the agent is asked to take when this is said, as verb.action (report.tell, change): named, never taken by the reflex itself.

input.description: The inputs of its action, as the action takes them; a name in braces ({run}) is filled in where it is said.

misses.description: The refusals it answers, as a list of phrases: a refused change of a run whose reason holds one of them is that miss.

links.title: answers
links.description: An instruction (a reflex among them) said so that this miss does not happen again: a bump, an issue, a refusal written down. Whether it did is read per run, from what came after it was said.
